glosses: capacity (measure of the ability to hold)

examples.en: He has confidence in his ability.

examples.text: Tenía un buen concepto de sus capacidades.
examples.en: He had a high opinion of her abilities.
Do you have the ability to do that?

examples.text: No tengo mucha fe en sus capacidades.
examples.en: I don't have much faith in his ability.

examples.text: Ojalá tuviera la capacidad para hacer eso.
examples.en: I wish I had the ability to do that.
